strings.무슨 생각을 하기에 부르는 소리도 못 들어요?: What are you thinking about so hard that you can't hear me calling?
strings.아, 오셨군요. 무슨 일이십니까?: Oh, you're here. What can I do for you?
I don't think I properly thanked you for your help.
Please, I learned more from the experience myself.
I'm not sure whether to call this a problem... But there's something I need to tell you.
I don't know if I can help, but I'll listen.
strings.무슨 이야기이기에 이렇게 겁을 먹어요? 혹시 귀신이라도 옆에 있어요?: What's gotten you so frightened? Is there a ghost beside you or something?
I'm ashamed to let you see me like this. Sigh...
strings.제나 님을 만나고 나서부터 제 눈에 보이지 않았던 것들이 보이기 시작합니: Ever since I met Lady Jenna, I've begun seeing things I couldn't see before. I thought she was the only exception...
strings.이리스 님의 것으로 보이는 심상세계의 문도 보이고. 그 안에 있는 정령들: I can see what appears to be the entrance to Lady Iris's Inner World, and the spirits inside.
strings.가끔 실체화를 해서 모습을 보이는 정령들은 본 적이 있습니다. 그건 정령: I've seen spirits take physical form occasionally, but that's different. They chose to appear before humans.
I'm all right. Things just turned out that way...
I'm not. It's different from Ull's keen spiritual perception...
strings.마족과도 싸워 이긴 엘은 왜 귀신이나 영혼을 무서워하나요?: You've defeated fiends in battle, Ell. Why are you afraid of ghosts and souls?
Perhaps because my older brother used to frighten me with them when I was little.
So you'd rather not see them. But what about Jenna...?
strings.제나 님만 보이고 다른 건 안 보이는 그런 방법 같은 게 없겠습니까?: Isn't there some way to let me see only Lady Jenna and nothing else?
I'll go speak with a Spirit King.
strings.가, 감사합니다. 제가 받들어 모실 테니 제발 부탁드립니다!!: Th-thank you! I'll serve you faithfully, so please help me!!
strings.그건 괜찮아요. 제가 도와준다고 했으니 금방 다녀올게요!: That won't be necessary. I said I'd help, so I'll be back soon!
strings.기쁜 마음으로 기다리고 있겠습니다!: I'll wait eagerly for your return!
Harmonia, I came to ask a favor.
strings.네, 전에도 말씀드렸지만… 루맨에 계시는 분들과 관련된 일은 어느 정도: Yes. As I mentioned before, I know something of matters involving the people in Lumen.
strings.엘 님이 겁을 내시는 건 유물의 영향이에요. 볼 수 있는 존재에게는 무적: The relic is responsible for Ell's fear. She is nearly invincible against things she can see, but she fears what she cannot.
strings.(진실의 불꽃…. 하긴, 고대 유물의 영향이라면 그럴 수도 있어.): (The Flame of Truth... An ancient relic could certainly have that effect.)
Suddenly seeing things that were invisible before would make anyone uneasy. However...
strings.엘 님은 특수한 경우라 갑자기 그런 존재들을 보이지 않게 하는 건 조금: Ell is a special case. It may be difficult to suddenly make those beings invisible to her again.
I can make some medicine instead.
strings.그걸 먹으면 어느 정도 제어할 수 있어요. 보고 싶지 않은 존재를 지울: Taking it would give her some control. She could erase beings she doesn't wish to see... I can make it using the necklace's power, but...
I'm worried I might disappoint her.
strings.그러면 괜찮지 않을까요?: Then wouldn't it be all right?
strings.엘 님에게 약을 가져다 주실 때 꼭 물어봐 주세요. 제가 만들어 드리긴: When you bring Ell the medicine, please be sure to ask her. I may have made it, but whether to take it is entirely her choice. Some choices inevitably leave regrets.
strings.그럴게요. 그런데 바로 만들어 주실 수 있나요?: I will. Can you make it right away?
strings.바로는 힘들 것 같아요. 재료가 필요해서 모험가님께서 구해다 주셔야 해요: Not immediately. I need you to gather the ingredients. Once you bring them, I'll purify them with the necklace's power.
strings.모험가님이 만났던 가짜 뱀의 흔적이 필요해요. 비늘과 뿔 하나씩 있으면: Remnants of the false serpent you encountered. One scale and one horn will do.
strings.가지고 있는 걸 주셔도 되고, 없으시다면 구하신 곳에서 찾으시면 금방 구: You can give me ones you already have. If you don't have any, you should find them easily where you obtained them before.
strings.그러면 심상세계에서 나갔다가 재료를 가지고 다시 와주시겠어요? 말로 설명: Would you leave the Inner World, then return with the ingredients? I can't quite explain it in words, but it's because of the necklace's power.
Oh, all right. I'll see you shortly.
strings.(모험가가 심상세계를 빠져나가자 하르모니아 옆으로 천천히 기아스가 걸어온: (Once the adventurer leaves the Inner World, Geis slowly approaches Harmonia.)
The adventurer was here. The feeling is certainly different from before.
You sensed it too. The adventurer is certainly...
strings.나는 그대의 생각을 모르겠군. 그래도 그대는 그대의 위치에서 최선을 다하: I don't understand your thoughts. Still, you are doing your best within your role, so I will say no more.
I do commend you for allowing the human who needs the medicine to choose.
strings.전에도 말했지만, 레다 님께서 주신 목걸이의 선택이 불행이 아니길 빌고: As I said before, I hope the choice made by Lady Leda's necklace does not bring misfortune. If it does, we must help.
strings.그대가 뭐라 해도 예정된 수순이네. 그대도 나도 신의 손에서 태어난 정령: Whatever you say, that is the course we must take. You and I are spirits born from a god's hands. We must accept it.
Yes. I brought what you asked for.
(Harmonia takes the horn and scale, gathering them in her hands with the necklace she holds.)
(After a moment, the horn and scale change shape, becoming a small white bead.)
The will of creation has taken a new form.
I simply used the will within a part of Ouroboros.
For us, perhaps not knowing would be more difficult.
strings.(하르모니아가 손안에서 만들어진 작은 보석을 건네준다.): (Harmonia hands you the small jewel formed in her palms.)
Please take this to Ell. And remember to ask her.
I will. Thank you, Harmonia. And...
I'll go see Ell, then. Thank you, Harmonia.
strings.(하르모니아의 말에 순간 하려던 말을 잊어버렸네. 그런데 무슨 말을 하려: (Harmonia's words made me forget what I was about to say. What was it...?)
strings.(모험가가 심상세계의 문을 통해 사라졌을 때, 태연했던 하르모니아가 주저: (As the adventurer disappears through the entrance to the Inner World, Harmonia's composure breaks, and she sinks to the ground.)
Is this what Lady Leda meant? What does this necklace want...?
strings.(엘에게 조화와 안정의 정령왕 하르모니아의 도움을 받았다고 전한다.): (You tell Ell that Harmonia, Spirit King of Harmony and Stability, helped you.)
strings.그런 존재가 계셨군요. %s 님은 그런 분에게서 신뢰를 받을 정도니 정말: So such a being exists. You're remarkable, %s, to have earned the trust of someone like that.
strings.이리스를 찾아 여기까지 오면서 많은 사람을 만났어요. 저를 이해해주고,: I've met so many people on my journey to find Iris. People who understand me, and people I want to understand...
Those are what we call bonds.
strings.오라버니께서 그러셨어요. 그런 게 느껴졌다면 인연이란 정말 좋은 선물을: My brother used to say that if you felt that connection, you had received the wonderful gift of a bond.
I see. A gift... Oh, that reminds me. I have a gift for you, Ell.
strings.(엘이 약을 받아들고 빤히 쳐다본다.): (Ell takes the medicine and gazes at it.)
strings.안 보이던 것이 바로 보일 수는 있어도, 보였던 게 바로 사라지지 않고,: What was invisible can suddenly become visible, yet what I've seen won't simply disappear. I can control it, but I won't stop seeing everything entirely...
strings.하르모니아가 약을 먹는 건 온전히 엘의 선택이라는 말을 했어요. 일종의: Harmonia said whether to take the medicine is entirely your choice. It seemed like something she wanted you to understand.
strings.당분간 보이지 않던 걸 보게 된 걸 즐겨보려고 합니다. 시선을 넓혔다고: For now, I'll try to enjoy seeing what I couldn't see before. If I think of it as broadening my perspective, it might even help my swordsmanship...
strings.하하. 역시 엘 다워요. 엘이라면 이겨내고 더 훌륭한 검의 길을 갈 수: Haha. That's just like you, Ell. I'm sure you'll overcome this and advance even further on the path of the sword.
strings.이 약은 제가 가지고 있다가 정말 견딜 수 없을 때가 오면…. 부디 그때: I'll keep this medicine for a time when I truly can't endure it... I only hope that time never comes.
strings.마음이 한결 가벼워졌습니다. 약이 아니라 제 마음가짐이 문제였을지도 모르: I feel much lighter. Perhaps it wasn't medicine I needed, but a change in my outlook. I'll continue training here.
Thank you. I'll see you again.
strings.(모험가가 화이트 콜 협곡을 떠나고, 엘이 수련을 하기 위해 검을 휘두른: (After the adventurer leaves White Col Canyon, Ell begins swinging her sword in practice.)
strings.잠깐, 거기 누구? 언제부터 거기 있었지?: Wait. Who's there? How long have you been there?
strings.(어디 있는 거야? 왜 보이지 않는 건데…?): (Where are you? Why can't I see you...?)
strings.(경계하고 있던 엘의 복부로 거대한 공격이 들어온다. 충격을 받은 엘이: (As Ell stands on guard, a tremendous blow strikes her abdomen. She crumples to the ground.)
This power... There's no mistaking it...
The one who killed my brother Elysion...
strings.(엘이 정신을 잃고 쓰러지면서 품에 있던 약이 떨어진다. 그리고 엘을 공: (Ell collapses unconscious, and the medicine falls from her clothes. The person who attacked her picks it up.)
